approach: Re-home the two genuine straggler classifiers (A1 added-char-count, A4 diacritic-mechanism) onto type aliases of the existing contracts enums (Scale, DiacriticBehavior), mirroring the pattern A7 spare-key-budget already uses correctly against KeyBudgetBand. Add two Expect-AssignableTo compile-time guards and one new runtime lockstep test. A7 needs no change - research found it already properly sourced.

decisions.decision: Scoped this feature to A1 and A4 only, not all three axis-valued facets the spec names
decisions.why: Research found A7 spare-key-budget already derives from a contracts type (KeyBudgetBand) via a bijective, tested projection function (spec 052 FR-016) - it is not a straggler despite the spec assuming otherwise
decisions.rejected: Re-plumbing A7 to reference SpareKeyAvailability directly, which would violate FR-007 byte-identical-output for a facet that already satisfies the features intent through a different, already-correct mechanism

decisions.decision: Resolved FR-010s locked-field gating question as NO before task generation
decisions.why: Grepped both straggler classifiers and their YAMLs - neither references StrategyId or any Pattern field; Article I does not trigger
decisions.rejected: Leaving the gating question open for a later phase, which the spec explicitly says plan.md must not do

plan.summary: Type-alias two straggler facet-index classifiers onto existing contracts enums, add compile-time + runtime drift guards; no new enumeration, no runtime-behavior change
plan.key_finding: The spec named three axis-valued facets as stragglers; only two (A1, A4) actually are - A7 is already correctly sourced via a bijective projection from KeyBudgetBand
